title: RFC 3977 conformance test: slrn against live reader
description: Drive slrn (or tin) against a running usenet-ipfs-reader process. Verify: CAPABILITIES lists required extensions, GROUP selects a group, OVER returns overview rows, ARTICLE fetches full article text, POST accepts and stores an article. Record slrn session transcript as a test fixture. Why: per project spec, RFC 3977 conformance must be validated with real unmodified newsreader clients, not mock sessions.
